name: AUM Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah
meaning: I offer salutations to Shanaishchara, the slow-moving planetary force Saturn.
purpose: A short devotional salutation associated with Shani.
supports: Patience; consistency; accountability; steadiness during delays.
when: During Saturday reflection, or when working on a long-term commitment.
note: A simple nama-style formula. Traditions differ in exact bija and pronunciation.
